title: Resource activation
idea: Resource activation: An unclaimed resource identity leads through ownership eligibility and a final assignment review.
audience: People who need to activate resource within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: An entitlement or physical token must be assigned securely.
avoidWhen: Possessing a URL is treated as unrestricted administrative authority.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic process layout through its activate resource priority and explicit commitment contract: Enforce atomic server-side claiming and distinguish already-assigned or revoked tokens.
navigation: Resource activation keeps the current activate resource context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: An unclaimed resource identity leads through ownership eligibility and a final assignment review.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to activate resource; an entitlement or physical token must be assigned securely.
composition.priority: Enforce atomic server-side claiming and distinguish already-assigned or revoked tokens.

imagery.role: Support the actual activate resource context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep one assignment decision at a time with a visible resource summary.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the resource activation structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no activate resource content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Enforce atomic server-side claiming and distinguish already-assigned or revoked tokens.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized activate resource content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Enforce atomic server-side claiming and distinguish already-assigned or revoked tokens.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active activate resource context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
